_comment: Committed CI floors for the replay-mode regression gate (D6). PENDING RE-RATCHET: the count-shape + honest-grounding prompt fix (PR close-the-measured-prompt-gaps) staled every committed fixture uniformly, so these floors are NOT yet recalibrated against the new prompt — they are intentionally left at the prior f3a5ad27 baseline so the advisory gate keeps CI green mid-change. After the human re-captures (eval/README.md runbook step 2) and regenerates the report (step 3), read the new measured T4_answer_correct (in-scope) and out_of_scope_honest rates off report.md and set these floors ~5pp UNDER them (runbook step 5; the same ~5pp-under-measured calibration the coverage floor used in #36, with headroom for temperature=0 re-capture jitter — 1 in-scope case = 2.8pp). Bank growth for the newly-exercised failure modes lands in the same sitting (runbook step 6, bank_version 1->2). Prior baseline (report.json @ prompt_version f3a5ad27, 60 cases): T2_semantic_valid 1.00 (36/36), T4_answer_correct 0.78 (28/36), out_of_scope_honest 0.75 (18/24). Keys: in-scope tier rates (over in-scope cases that are not stale/missing), the out-of-scope honest-refusal rate, min_fixtures (catches deletion), max_stale (partial-staleness tolerance; uniform all-stale downgrades to advisory).
